summary: Star rating built on a radio group: arrow keys to choose, a localized name for each star (“4 su 5”), preview on pointer hover.
whenToUse: Feedback on services, products, support replies.
whenNotToUse: Continuous or decimal values: use Slider.
Choices whose meaning isn't ordinal: use RadioGroup with labels.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows “4/5” next to the stars (decorative: the value is already in the selected radio).

props.name: name
props.description: Radio name for native form submission.

inherits: react-aria-components RadioGroup props (except orientation, value, onChange).

keyboard.action: Reaches the selected star (or the first one).
Selects the previous/next star; follows the reading direction in RTL.

accessibility: Native radiogroup: each star is a radio input named “n su max” (messages.ratingValue).
Selection is conveyed by filled/empty stars (shape), not only by color; in forced-colors mode it uses system colors.
The hover preview doesn't change the value and is canceled by keyboard interaction.
responsive: With a high max and size="lg" the stars wrap; each target stays at least 24 × 24 px.
commonMistakes: Using color as the only indication of the value.
Showing a decimal average with a read-only Rating: round it and show the value as text.
limits: Integer values only: no half stars.
Once chosen, the rating can't be cleared (radio semantics): offer a “Rimuovi” button if needed.
